name: Luminous Tide Wheel
description: A massive wheel turned by the tide, its paddles illuminated with shifting colors as they move.
prompt: Enormous tidal wheel embedded in a shoreline, its paddles glowing with shifting teal and amber as seawater lifts and drops them, sunrise reflecting on water, epic scale.
caption: Ride the luminous tide—watch the wheel paint the waves. 🌊⚙️
